tfidf_reasoning_baseline.note: TF-IDF reasoning-only baseline on 1,200 BGer decisions. Fails all legal-quality metrics.

neural_multilingual_baseline.note: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2 (768-dim) on 1,000 BGer decisions. Beats TF-IDF on hierarchy, purity, stability. Fails citation proximity and neighbor relevance.

comparison.critical_finding: Neural embeddings have very high cross-language similarity (0.87) but negative separation (-0.05), meaning language still dominates over legal area. However, the hierarchy is much more coherent (NMI 0.51 vs 0.03) and clusters are purer (0.88 vs 0.70). The product can use neural embeddings as a starting point, but legal-specific fine-tuning is needed to improve citation proximity and multilingual separation.
